scripts.build: npm run build:circuit && npm run build:program
scripts.build:circuit: xark --version | grep -q '^xark 0\.3\.' || { echo 'needs xark 0.3: see ../RUNBOOK.md' >&2; exit 1; }; xark build circuit && xark setup circuit --r1cs-form reduced && (cd circuit && cargo run -q --release --example demo) && xark export circuit --crate-name token-claim-xark-verifier && xark client circuit --out client/
scripts.test:circuit: xark test circuit && cd program && cargo test -q --release
